next.reason: 1985 GR21: an unavailable optional file opened EXTEND or I-O is created 'as if' OPEN OUTPUT, CLOSE, then the OPEN; OPEN OUTPUT creates the file, which then 'contains no data records'. §2023:14.9.27.4 GR17 states the same creation sequence ('the OPEN statement creates the file' as if OPEN OUTPUT file-name-1. CLOSE file-name-1.), §2023:14.9.27.4 GR18 'After the creation of the file, the file contains no records', Table 18 in §2023:14.9.27.4 GR4 and status 05 in §2023:9.1.13.2 GR4 restate it (1985 had status 05 too). Page positioning in GR18 concerns only physical pages, outside 1985 GR21.
